## Observation
On Windows, `git show <rev>:<path>` run without `--` dies with exit 128 and `fatal: failed to stat '<rev>:<path>': Filename too long` when the working directory plus the argument exceeds MAX_PATH. Git stats each revision argument as a possible filename to rule out ambiguity, and it aborts on any stat error other than ENOENT. Measured in Windows `sweep (windows)` diagnostic run 44899637411 (2026-11-21 PST): `fsck_restore`'s `git show <sha>^:<ticket>/<event>.json` failed this way under a pytest temp dir. The same test passed under a shorter temp path (run 44899366277). With `git cat-file blob` (which takes only an object name) it passed (run 44900309390). cold-censorable-armedcrab fixes the `fsck_restore` sites. This ticket covers the rest.

## Sites on origin/main 1a11014a3a4 that read `<rev>:<path>` through `git show` with no `--`
- src/rebar/_commands/_init_ensures.py:98, :122, :164 (`tickets:.gitattributes`, `tickets:.gitignore`, `tickets:<compat>`)
- src/rebar/_commands/init.py:440 (`tickets:.pre-commit-config.yaml`)
- src/rebar/_commands/reclaim_publish.py:108 (`<rev>:<compat>`)
- src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py:151 (`<tickets ref>:<path>`)
- src/rebar/_opcert_gate_config.py:107 (`<spec>`)
- src/rebar/_store/compat.py:180, :274 (`<remote ref>:<compat>`)
- src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py:67 (`tickets:<projects.json>`)
- src/rebar/llm/evals/engine_comparison.py:217 (`HEAD:<path>`)

Bare-revision arguments, such as reclaim_eligibility.py:101 `show -s --format=%ct <sha>`, go through the same stat but are short enough to be unlikely to exceed the limit, so they are not listed. Several of the listed sites treat a non-zero exit as "absent", so a deep Windows path would misread an existing object as missing. One example is the `_init_ensures` units, which would then re-create and commit a file that exists.

## Hypotheses (unproven per site)
Every site above can hit this on a deep enough Windows path. Short ref:path pairs under a shallow tracker path stay under MAX_PATH and never do.

## Proposed direction
Route these reads through `git cat-file blob <rev>:<path>`, or add `--` after the revision, and add a regression test that drives each read with a cwd deep enough to exceed MAX_PATH on Windows.
